title: THE SUPPORT MG NO LONGER BUILDS INTO A HEAVY SHAKE
why: His Q5: gun feel. The Support MG fires every 105 ms. At the flat 2.2 kick each round adds 0.157 trauma and only 0.147 drains, so a held 60 round magazine climbed into a heavy shake (the same fault the SMG had). 2.0 adds 0.143, so it holds at about 0.3 px.
now: The Support MG no longer builds into a heavy shake.

edits.replacement: var GUN_SHAKE={shotgun:6.5,smg:1.9,pistol:3.6,rifle:2.7,magnum:5.5,lmg:2.0};   // v28.xx (cw-kicklmg): the Support MG 2.2 to 2.0, so a held 60 round magazine (105 ms a round, trauma drains 0.147 a round, 2.2 adds 0.157) no longer climbs into a heavy shake; 2.0 adds 0.143 and the measured shake of a held magazine stays about 0.3 px
